Sales & Marketing Manager (Luxury Fashion Brand) Job at Maybrands Limited




        
    

        
        Maybrands is the No.1 Retailer of FOSSIL products in Nigeria. We are the only licensed store to sell fossil products in Nigeria, these Include;  Fossil, Skagen, Emporio Armani, Diesel, Michael Kors, DKNY, Armani Exchange, Chaps, Nixon. You can find all your fashion accessories for both women and men.

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Sales & Marketing Manager (Luxury Fashion Brand)

Job Location: Jabi, Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time

Description
     

            
    




	DKYN is a premium luxury fashion retailer committed to delivering exceptional timepieces and outstanding customer experiences. We are seeking a dynamic and commercially driven professional to lead our Abuja store operations while driving sales growth, business development, and brand visibility.


Role Overview


	The Sales & Marketing Manager will manage day-to-day operations at the Abuja outlet, drive sales performance, lead and develop store associates, build strategic partnerships, and represent the brand to high-value customers and stakeholders.
	The successful candidate will play a key role in growing the brand's presence within Abuja's luxury retail market while ensuring an exceptional customer experience.


Key Responsibilities


	Drive sales growth and achieve revenue targets through effective customer engagement and relationship management.
	Manage daily operations, presentation, and overall store performance.
	Lead, supervise, and motivate store sales associates to deliver excellent customer service and achieve individual and team targets.
	Develop and maintain relationships with high-net-worth individuals (HNIs), corporate clients, and strategic partners.
	Identify and execute business development, networking, and partnership opportunities that enhance brand visibility and generate sales.
	Serve as a brand ambassador at events, client meetings, and other business engagements.
	Ensure excellent customer experience, inventory accountability, and adherence to company standards.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, Retail Management, or a related field.
	Minimum of 5 years' experience in luxury retail, premium fashion retail, luxury watches, jewelry, lifestyle brands, or a similar high-end retail environment, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or managerial capacity.
	Proven ability to drive sales, close high-value transactions, and build lasting customer relationships.
	Strong business development, networking, negotiation, and partnership management skills.
	Demonstrated experience managing retail operations and leading high-performing sales teams.
	Excellent communication, interpersonal, presentation, and leadership skills.
	Experience working with luxury retail brands is a strong advantage.
	An existing network within Abuja's corporate, business, or luxury lifestyle community is an added advantage.
	Female candidates are encouraged to apply as part of our commitment to promoting gender balance within the organization.
    

    

        Click here to Apply

Job Description


	We are seeking a highly experienced and results-driven Head of Accounts to lead our finance and accounting operations.
	The ideal candidate will be responsible for overseeing the company&#39;s financial reporting, budgeting, payroll, taxation, reconciliations, compliance, and audit activities while providing strategic financial insights to support business growth and decision-making.
	This role requires a strong accounting professional with proven experience in financial management, reporting, regulatory compliance, and team leadership.


Key Responsibilities


	Lead and manage the company&#39;s accounting and financial reporting functions across all business locations.
	Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports, including Profit &amp; Loss Statements, Management Accounts, Balance Sheets, Income Statements, and other financial reports required by Management.
	Manage monthly payroll processing and ensure accuracy in payroll-related accounting entries.
	Perform financial reconciliations including bank accounts, trade receivables, trade payables, stock records, fixed assets, and inter-branch accounts.
	Analyze financial statements, revenue trends, expenditures, and budgets, providing insights and recommendations to support strategic decision-making.
	Prepare and monitor annual budgets and financial forecasts, ensuring effective expenditure control and cost management.
	Review accounting records, invoices, payment schedules, and financial transactions to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with accounting standards.
	Oversee taxation and statutory compliance, including the preparation and filing of tax returns and other regulatory reports required by Federal, State, and Local Government authorities.
	Coordinate internal and external audits, ensuring all supporting documentation, reconciliations, and financial records are readily available and compliant.
	Supervise and mentor the Accounts Officers, providing guidance, support, and oversight to ensure operational excellence within the Accounts function.
	Develop, improve, and maintain accounting systems, financial databases, and reporting processes to drive efficiency, accuracy, and business performance.
	Prepare management reports and ad-hoc financial analyses to support business planning, operational performance, and executive decision-making.
	Ensure the security and integrity of financial information, including maintaining proper records, backups, and documentation of key financial processes.
	Drive continuous improvement in financial controls, governance, and compliance practices while supporting the achievement of organizational goals.
	Perform any other finance, accounting, or business-related duties assigned by Management.


Qualifications &amp; Experience


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
	Minimum of 5&ndash;10 years of relevant experience in Accounting, Finance, Audit, Financial Control, or a related function within a corporate or professional services environment.
	Professional certification such as ACA, ACCA, ICAN, CFA, or equivalent is required.


Required Skills &amp; Competencies:


	Strong financial accounting and reporting background.
	Sound knowledge of International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS).
	Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial reporting tools.
	Strong knowledge of QuickBooks and other accounting software applications.
	Good understanding of Nigerian tax laws and financial regulations.
	Excellent analytical, budgeting, forecasting, and financial management skills.
	Strong attention to detail and ability to work with large volumes of financial data.
	Excellent communication, planning, and organizational skills.
	Ability to multitask, meet deadlines, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
	Strong leadership and stakeholder management capabilities.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook).

Wealth Manager Job at Rubels and Angels Food Court




        
    

        
        Rubels and Angels is a fast-paced, moving hospitality business with a restaurant for fine dining, takeout, and online booking. Rubels and Angels is unique and dynamic and equips one with all the necessary tools needed to work effectively, as growth is our watchword and standard.

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Wealth Manager

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description
     

            
    




	Responsible for providing personalized financial planning and investment advisory services to high-net-worth clients, helping them grow, protect, and manage their wealth in line with their financial goals.


Responsibilities


	Develop and manage personalized wealth/investment strategies for clients
	Advise clients on investment portfolios, asset allocation, and risk management
	Build and maintain strong client relationships, ensuring trust and retention
	Monitor market trends and adjust client portfolios accordingly
	Provide guidance on tax planning, estate planning, and retirement strategies
	Prepare and present periodic portfolio performance reports to clients
	Identify new business opportunities and grow client base
	Ensure compliance with financial regulations and company policies
	Collaborate with legal, tax, and investment teams on client solutions
	Stay updated on financial products, market conditions, and regulatory changes


Requirements
Education:


	Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or related field
	Professional certification strongly preferred (CFA, CFP, ICAN, ACCA, or equivalent)
	Master's degree (MBA or related) is an added advantage


Experience:


	Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in wealth management, investment banking, or financial advisory, with a proven track record of managing high-net-worth client portfolios


Skills:


	Strong financial analysis and investment knowledge
	Excellent relationship management and interpersonal skills
	Strategic and analytical thinking
	Strong communication and presentation skills
	Sales and business development acumen
	Proficiency in financial planning tools/software


Other Requirements:


	High level of integrity, confidentiality, and professionalism
	Strong network/connections with high-net-worth individuals is an advantage
	Regulatory licensing/certification as required by jurisdiction
	Ability to work under pressure and meet client/business targets.


Salary
N250,000 - N500,000 monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and Cover letter to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.
